Hello, thank you for contributing to the Godot engine!

New features like this need a corresponding proposal on the [godot-proposals](https://github.com/godotengine/godot-proposals/issues) repository. If the proposal accumulates enough interest, it will be considered for merge. I did not find an existing one for `Stack`, so please open one for this feature. You may also be interested in looking into the [contributions workflow](https://docs.godotengine.org/en/latest/contributing/workflow/index.html) :)

That being said, it is possible to 'emulate' a `Stack` data type by pushing and popping the final items of `Array` instances, without performance cost. This is the current recommended solution to this problem (and looking at your code, it's what you're doing as well). Data types based on `RefCounted` have significant performance overhead, and are therefore not desirable for general purpose collections.

_(as an aside, I'll plug my own [custom Variant](https://github.com/godotengine/godot-proposals/issues/11797) proposal, which would make it possible to add a `Stack` type via GDExtension at no performance cost)_

Thank you for the suggestion. I will submit a proposal first and close this PR.
